prompt: After reading an int, nextLine() returns an empty string. Why?
choices: nextLine() is not compatible with Scanner
nextInt() consumes the integer but leaves the newline in the buffer — nextLine() reads that leftover newline
name must be declared before age
explanation: nextInt() reads the token '25' but stops before the newline character. The subsequent nextLine() reads up to the leftover newline, returning an empty string. Fix: add an extra sc.nextLine() after nextInt() to consume the newline before reading the name.
